entities.summary: Nagma Mohamed Mallick is an Indian civil servant of the Indian Foreign Service. She holds the rank of Secretary/Grade I of the government. She is currently the Ambassador of India to Japan from 2025 onwards. Previously, she served as Ambassador of India to Republic of Poland and the Republic of Lithuania from 2021 till 2025. On 29 June 2015 she was appointed as the High Commissioner of India to Brunei Darussalam. Before this posting, she served as India's Ambassador to Tunisia from October 2012 to November 2015.
